title: El corte de la roca: De Lesseps a la soberanía canalera
goal: Analyze the epic construction of the Panama Canal, French failure, US enclave, and the 1977 Torrijos-Carter sovereignty treaties using historical discourse.

sections.title: Unit 8: Panama — Lesson 2
body: Welcome to lesson 2 of Unit 8 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Panama: The Interoceanic Crossroads, Global Commerce & Afro-Antillean Identity.
In this lesson, we study el corte de la roca: de lesseps a la soberanía canalera, evaluating Panama's physical geography, sovereignty struggles, cultural pluralism, and economic paradoxes.

items: Analyze the epic construction of the Panama Canal, French failure, US enclave, and the 1977 Torrijos-Carter sovereignty treaties using historical discourse.
Master the lexicon and discourse of historia-canal-panama-soberania.
Incorporate regional terminology (la soberanía, el enclave).
